note: Chapter 1 keys the long ball from 'A long ball', the bounce from 'bounces past Otamendi', the run from 'Randal Kolo Muani' / 'is through' and the set from 'one on one'; the save plays in the tail after 'one on one'. Chapter 2 freezes near the contact on 'his left leg'. Read 'Lusail' as loo-SAIL.

chapters.label: The last minute
chapters.text: Lusail, 2022. The World Cup final, the very last minute of extra time. A long ball bounces past Otamendi. Randal Kolo Muani is through, one on one!

chapters.label: Watch the save
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Emiliano Martínez races off his line, spreads his arms and legs wide, and blocks the shot with his left leg!

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal, see how little space he leaves. Argentina went on to win the World Cup!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn, keepers: rush out fast to close the angle, then make yourself big. Spread your arms and legs wide!
